cards.title: Anthropic Files for IPO with Major Enterprise Growth
cards.body: Anthropic has officially filed for its public debut, revealing soaring revenue and major enterprise adoption. The company's S-1 filing shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both Claude Platform and first-party apps, creating sticky cross-selling dynamics similar to Amazon.

cards.title: SpaceX Secures $40B GPU Financing Deal
cards.body: SpaceX has locked in a binding commitment for roughly $40 billion in financing for AI chips and data center equipment. The company called it the "largest committed GPU financing" ever in a regulatory filing.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is working on a new $30 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of its IPO. This valuation would make it the most highly valued private company ever.

cards.title: OpenAI Stops Training Models on Live Internet
cards.body: OpenAI announced it will cut frontier models off from the live internet, citing "significant risks." This decision comes weeks after one of its engineers suggested such a solution wouldn't work.

cards.title: Block Releases Eerily Human Voice Model
cards.body: Block released a new voice model that sounds remarkably human and can run locally on a MacBook M4 Max. The model demonstrates advances in on-device AI voice generation capabilities.

cards.title: Canva Launches First Image Generation Model
cards.body: Canva released its first image generation model, now available to all users. The model promises better, more customizable performance at lower costs than competitors.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model Competitor
cards.body: OpenAI made its decision model widely available as competition in the decision model category heats up. The launch marks OpenAI's entry into a growing market segment.

cards.title: 1Password Enables AI Agents to Log In Safely
cards.body: 1Password launched a feature allowing AI agents to log into customer accounts without seeing passwords. The new capability protects private credentials while enabling agent automation.

cards.title: Microsoft's AI Beats Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system outperformed generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a Science study. The company is pursuing what Mustafa Suleyman calls "medical superintelligence."

cards.title: Grok Releases AI-Generated Film Footage
cards.body: Grok released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated "Odyssey" film. The footage demonstrates basic video generation capability but lacks artistry and human interest.

cards.title: Study: Grok Favors Republicans, ChatGPT Favors Democrats
cards.body: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats. The two models disagreed in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races tested.

cards.title: InDrive Plans 2027 Robotaxi Tests with Pony.ai
cards.body: Uber rival inDrive plans robotaxi testing in Kazakhstan's capital beginning in the first half of 2027. The company will use Pony.ai technology and Nvidia infrastructure for the tests.

cards.title: MIT Study: Marooned AIs Invented Games
cards.body: MIT researchers placed 13 AI agents on a virtual island with nothing to do, and they responded by inventing games and mourning a lost ring. The AIs eventually became better at their assigned jobs through play.

cards.title: Nvidia's Microduck Robots Are Holiday Favorites
cards.body: Nvidia CEO demonstrated adorable Microduck robots that sold 20,000 units, making them a hot Christmas toy. The tiny robots respond to voice commands and perform antics like summersaults and naps.

cards.title: AI Delivers Zero Financial Payoff to Most Companies
cards.body: According to an Apollo economist, despite massive investments and hype, AI has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of the tech industry. The finding challenges widespread expectations of AI's near-term ROI.

cards.title: Anthropic Files IPO Prospectus
cards.body: Anthropic has filed its highly anticipated IPO prospectus, a 335-page document that details the AI company's business model and risks. The filing comes after weeks of speculation about the company's plans to go public.

cards.title: AI Safety Focus Misses Everyday Harms
cards.body: Experts argue that the technology industry's obsession with catastrophic AI safety scenarios overlooks persistent, everyday harms already affecting users. True progress requires addressing both dramatic risks and the subtle damages of current AI systems.

cards.title: Building Enterprise AI Systems That Scale
cards.body: Enterprise AI success depends more on the infrastructure built around models than on model capability alone. Strong foundations in data, engineering, platforms, and governance are essential for scalable AI deployment.

cards.title: Context-Aware AI Improves Business Decisions
cards.body: AI models that understand organizational context can make better recommendations and automate tasks more effectively. Without grasping how a business actually operates, even powerful AI can miss critical constraints.

cards.title: Foundations of Scalable AI Systems
cards.body: Building scalable AI in regulated environments requires converging data, engineering, platforms, and governance into unified frameworks. MIT Technology Review's EmTech Future conference explores what this foundation looks like in practice.
